risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: CarGurus operates in a highly competitive environment with major players such as Autotrader, Cars.com, and TrueCar, requiring continuous innovation to maintain its leadership position in traffic

risks.title: Technological Dependence
risks.score_rationale: The CarGurus platform relies on critical technologies and advanced algorithms for buyer-dealer matching and predictive intelligence

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: CarGurus operates across multiple jurisdictions (United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Ireland) with evolving regulations that may require operational adjustments

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: CarGurus has partnerships with automotive financing companies for customer connection services and is exposed to credit default risks

risks.title: Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: CarGurus handles sensitive consumer and dealer data on its marketplace platform, making it vulnerable to attacks that could compromise trust and compliance

risks.title: Macroeconomic Risks
risks.score_rationale: Demand for automotive marketplace services is cyclical and sensitive to economic conditions, interest rates, and consumer confidence

risks.title: Dependence on Business Partners
risks.score_rationale: CarGurus depends on dealers for vehicle inventory and on financing partners for financing and advertising services

ai_positioning.summary: CarGurus is gradually integrating artificial intelligence into its platform, particularly through AI-powered inventory intelligence and advanced analytics solutions. Following the wind-down of CarOffer, the company is focusing on analytical technologies and sourcing intelligence rather than direct transactions.
evidence: AI-powered inventory intelligence through insights platform
Continued focus on technology and analytics for smarter sourcing and pricing decisions
Data-driven products and predictive intelligence platform for dealers
